verdict.rationale: FFmpeg's official docs show format conversion (ffmpeg -i input.mp4 output.avi), explicit video bitrate control (-b:v 64k), and resizing via the scale filter in a filtergraph. Community users independently describe it as an indispensable transcoding multitool and report choosing specific encoders such as h264_nvenc. One user reported color information lost on Apple .mov files, an edge-case limitation rather than a contradiction. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of codec selection (e.g. -c:v/-c:a; encoder choice appears only in community reports), and evidence of audio bitrate control.
